description: A tuned lens on the tiny GPT-2 (5 layers, width 32): one affine translator `h + h W + b` per layer for layers 0 to 3, every layer but the last, all four in one featurizer over the layers axis (`over: ["layers"]`, `W` `[4, 32, 32]` and `b` `[4, 32]`, both zero at the draw), so each minibatch's one forward trains every layer's translator. The lens only reads: in the fit's body `apply` and `readout` are op steps over the read of `layer_output`, which leave the forward as it is, and each translated layer goes through the model's own final norm and head. Its objective is KL(final ‖ lens), the model's own next-token distribution scored against each layer's, written as `kl` of the lens (the side with the `layers` axis) with `reverse: true`. The logit lens (no translator) is scored on the held-out rows the same way, at the same 15 positions every row has, and `gain` is the tuned lens's held-out mean KL less the logit lens's, at each layer: exactly 0 at `epochs: 0`, where every translator is the identity, and below 0 once it trains. The model is random, so the numbers demonstrate the mechanics and nothing about what a lens learns.
